filter_note.note: Hand pass kept club-room injury/roster/staff/player news. Dropped MLB/NBA/NHL/MLS/F1/college (esp HOU/TEN/ARI bleed), celebrity/streamer, merch/gags/body-language filler, nostalgia>2y, near-dups, wrong-club leftovers, hype-anthem filler. Quiet OK for thin rooms after bleed.

items.title: Cardinals Coach Plans Rotation for Rookie RB Jeremiyah Love
items.one_line: After Love’s Week 1 burst (11 carries, 41 yards, a TD) plus an ankle note, Mike LaFleur says he’ll rotate Love with Tyler Allgeier for the long season ahead of Sunday’s home game vs. Seattle.

items.title: Falcons Turn to Cooper Rush for Home Opener vs. Panthers
items.one_line: Rush starts Sunday with Penix still out from ACL recovery and Tua Tagovailoa sidelined (oblique); undrafted Jack Strand backs up after Rush’s mixed Week 1 (143 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT).

items.title: Falcons QB Drama Builds Ahead of Panthers Home Opener
items.one_line: Penix and Rush were full participants Thursday while Tua missed; Stefanski takes it day by day as fans split on the unsettled Mercedes-Benz home opener.

items.title: Ravens Get Positive Injury News Ahead of Saints Home Opener
items.one_line: Zay Flowers returned limited after a hamstring but stays doubtful; Stanley/Simpson/Hendrickson questionable, Madubuike and others out; Brandin Cooks worked out as depth.

items.title: Ravens Face Injury Challenges Before Saints Home Opener
items.one_line: Thursday DNPs included Flowers, Hendrickson, Stanley, Simpson, and T.J. Tampa; Cooks workout after Ja’Kobi Lane IR wrist surgery; no signing yet.

items.title: Ravens Coordinator Doyle Stays Stone-Faced on Flowers' Big TD
items.one_line: First-year OC Declan Doyle: ‘You don’t smile until it hits zeroes’ after Flowers’ 54-yard TD in the 41-23 Colts win; fans love the intensity.

items.title: Bills Edge Lions 48-42 in High-Scoring TNF Thriller
items.one_line: Buffalo held off Detroit in a 90-point TNF shootout at new Highmark; Allen, Cook, Gibbs, and Amon-Ra fueled the card.

items.title: Bills Open New Highmark Stadium with Lions Win
items.one_line: Regular-season debut at the $2.1B Highmark Stadium; Allen scored early, baby bison mascot Bruce debuted, Bruce Smith on hand.

items.title: Nick Suss Named New Buffalo Bills Reporter for ESPN NFL Nation
items.one_line: Ex-Titans beat writer Suss takes the Bills NFL Nation desk; colleagues and fans welcomed him as the 2-0 Bills roll.

items.title: Panthers Turn to Giant DT Cam Jackson with Bobby Brown Out vs. Falcons
items.one_line: Bobby Brown III (back) out Sunday; Cam Jackson (6-6, 340) steps up vs. Bijan; Jones II Q (back); Coker and Waller cleared.

items.title: Bears Owners Met with Pritzker Aide Amid Indiana Stadium Push
items.one_line: Pat Ryan and Karen Murphy met Illinois Deputy Gov. Manar in August despite public Indiana focus; Goodell says both states still in play.

items.title: Ben Johnson's Explosive Plays Spark NFL Strategy Debate
items.one_line: After the 59-37 Panthers rout, debate over whether Johnson’s chunk-play scheme is a true revolution or recycled Air Coryell hype.

items.title: Joe Burrow Expected to Play Bengals-Texans Despite Back Tightness
items.one_line: Burrow limited Wed/Thu with back tightness but called sitting ‘ridiculous’; monitors toward Friday report vs. Houston’s pass rush.

items.title: Bengals Fans Challenge Orlovsky's Take on Week 1 Offense
items.one_line: Fans push back on Orlovsky’s ‘won in spite of the offense’ after 351 yards / 26 first downs / Burrow 25-of-35 for 254 in the TB win.

items.title: Texans GM Caserio Calls Bengals Offensive Line 'Myth' Narrative a Myth
items.one_line: Caserio praised CIN’s OL continuity (Orlando/Mims/Karras/Risner) ahead of Week 2; Bengals fans welcomed the nod after years of OL heat.

items.title: Baker Mayfield Faces Browns and Watson in Tampa Rematch
items.one_line: First NFL clash of Mayfield vs. Watson since Cleveland’s 2022 swap; both clubs 0-1 entering Raymond James.

items.title: Tony Grossi Switches to Shedeur Sanders Over Deshaun Watson for Browns
items.one_line: Grossi says Sanders is the better win path after Watson’s Week 1 (205 yds, TD, INT, 5 sacks); Monken sticking with Watson for now.

items.title: Browns Sign Jimmy Horn Jr. to Practice Squad, Reuniting Him with Shedeur Sanders
items.one_line: Ex-Panthers WR Horn signed to CLE PS after Week 1 muff/waiver; Deion called ahead; reunites Horn with Sanders.

items.title: Rookie Jaishawn Barham to Call Cowboys Defense vs. Commanders
items.one_line: With Overshown (hamstring) out, third-rounder Barham wears the green dot Sunday; six tackles in debut; Schottenheimer praised his communication.

items.title: Cowboys Host Commanders in Key NFC East Get-Right Clash
items.one_line: Both 0-1; Dak 13-2 vs. WSH historically; AT&T 4:25p FOX get-right game.

items.title: Cowboys Fans Slam 2023 Draft Class as Franchise Low Point
items.one_line: Mazi Smith / Schoonmaker / Overshown haul still drawing C- grades and fan anger three years later amid Overshown’s injury cloud.

items.title: Bo Nix Treats Broncos-Jaguars Clash as Must-Win After Week 1 Loss
items.one_line: After 31-10 KC loss (176 yards), Nix frames Sunday vs. Jacksonville as a playoff-style test at Mile High; alt and OL fixes top of mind.

items.title: Tim Tebow Returns to Plant Broncos Alumni Flag Before Jaguars Game
items.one_line: Broncos name Tebow Legend of the Game for Sunday’s home opener; Nix called him a childhood hero; JAX fans salty over Tebow’s past tryout.

items.title: Broncos Face Jaguars with Mims Out, Harvey Questionable
items.one_line: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) out; RJ Harvey Q (hamstring) after limited practices — big ST hit for the return game.

items.title: Lions Defense Crumbles in 41-31 Loss to Bills
items.one_line: DET allowed 41 points / 446 yards / five red-zone TDs; Orlovsky called the D a liability; Campbell said unacceptable after 910 yards allowed in two games.

items.title: Lions Fans Question Sewell's Switch to Left Tackle After Early Struggles
items.one_line: Penei Sewell’s LT move drew heat after a Chubb sack and low pass-pro grades vs. BUF; run blocking still strong; small sample noted.

items.title: Lions Fans Debate Letting Ben Johnson Leave After Bills Loss
items.one_line: Post-TNF talk revisits parting with Johnson (now CHI HC); Campbell 36-15 with him vs. 13-22-1 without.

items.title: Packers' Josh Jacobs Faces 4-6 Week NFL Suspension After Plea
items.one_line: Jacobs pleaded no contest to misdemeanor battery; on commissioner’s exempt since late Aug; ESPN: likely 4–6 game suspension as league seeks home video.

items.title: Packers Face Injury Questions Ahead of Jets Clash
items.one_line: Van Ness and Hargrave in concussion protocol (Hargrave doubtful); Banks/Bako-Bewele/St-Juste Q; Brinson out.

items.title: Packers Sign Veteran Guard Cordell Volson to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Ex-Bengals OG Volson (48 starts) signed to PS after OL struggled vs. MIN; low-risk depth ahead of Jets.

items.title: Nico Collins Ruled Out for Texans-Bengals Clash with Hamstring Strain
items.one_line: Grade 1 hamstring from Wed practice; Collins out Sunday after 7-75-1 in Week 1; depth thin with Higgins ACL / Dell IR — Noel/Hutchinson/Boutte up.

items.title: Colts Mostly Healthy Heading into Chiefs Week 2 Clash
items.one_line: Only Ashton Dulin (ankle) confirmed out; Anthony Richardson returned from groin tweak; Pierce full Friday and expects more snaps vs. KC.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence Shines in Jaguars' Dominant Week 1 Win
items.one_line: Lawrence 18-of-23 for 245 and 4 TDs in 34-10 Browns rout; Coen praised distribution; next: Denver.

items.title: Broncos Host Jaguars in Must-Win Home Opener After Week 1 Loss
items.one_line: JAX rides nine-game regular-season win streak into Mile High; DEN -2.5 / 45.5 after KC loss.

items.title: Travon Walker Named NFLPA Week 2 Community MVP for Feeding Jacksonville Students
items.one_line: Walker packed 500 meal bags with Blessings in a Backpack plus $5k; NFLPA added $10k to his foundation.

items.title: Chiefs Rule Out Simmons and Conner for Colts Game
items.one_line: LT Josh Simmons (back) and S Chamarri Conner out for SNF; Delane and Chris Jones Q after limited practice.

items.title: Bowers Doubtful, McConkey Questionable Ahead of Chargers-Raiders Clash
items.one_line: Kubiak: Brock Bowers limited Friday, still doubtful (pregame knee test); Chargers’ Ladd McConkey Q (ribs) after limited return; Molden/Pipkins out.

items.title: Raiders' Brock Bowers Returns to Practice but Doubtful vs. Chargers
items.one_line: Bowers in individual drills with knee sleeve after meniscus procedure; Kubiak hopes Week 3 vs. Saints if not Sunday.

items.title: Chargers-Raiders AFC West Clash Draws Record Fan Surge at SoFi
items.one_line: Raider Nation flooding SoFi; tickets spiked $24→$145; Herbert vs. Cousins Sunday 1:05p PT.

items.title: Harbaugh Names Awosika Full-Time Starter at Left Guard for Raiders Game
items.one_line: Kayode Awosika starts every snap at LG; Pipkins sidelined (knee); ends Week 1 rotation; lines up with Slater and Slaughter.

items.title: Key Injuries Cloud Chargers-Raiders Week 2 Clash
items.one_line: McConkey missed two practices (ribs) after Week 1 hit; Bowers still post-knee surgery; both clubs leaning on backups.

items.title: Aaron Donald Set for Rams Debut Against Giants After Two-Year Retirement
items.one_line: Donald confirmed for MNF vs. NYG after sitting Australia opener; McVay to manage workload; Myles Garrett on IR (knee) ≥4 weeks.

items.title: Puka Nacua Sits Out Practice with Hip Injury Ahead of Giants Game
items.one_line: Nacua missed Friday (hip) after full Thursday; first IR report this season; Whittington also out (quad); McVay update after Saturday.

items.title: Rams Coach McVay Vows No More Australia Trips After Loss
items.one_line: After 27-7 Melbourne loss, McVay hopes never to play Australia again citing 28-hour turnaround vs. SF’s week-long stay.

items.title: Dolphins' Chop Robinson Out with Concussion for 49ers Game
items.one_line: Edge Chop Robinson (third concussion in a year) out at SF after Wed practice hit; Harrison Jr. (hamstring) out; Addington Q (shoulder).

items.title: 49ers Heavy Favorites in Home Opener vs Dolphins
items.one_line: MIA 13.5-point dogs at Levi’s after 0-1 start; analysts lean SF 27-10 to 38-13; Achane vs. SF run D key.

items.title: Vikings Turn to Wentz with Murray Out vs. Healthy Bears
items.one_line: Kyler Murray (concussion) out at Soldier Field; Carson Wentz starts after 133 yards / 3 TDs in relief of Week 1; Murray eyed early next week.

items.title: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson Ready for Steelers Home Opener
items.one_line: Henderson practiced fully and said he’s ready after Week 1 ankle; shares backfield with Stevenson vs. PIT Sunday.

items.title: Patriots' Davis III Questionable for Steelers Home Opener with Neck Injury
items.one_line: Carlton Davis III three DNPs (neck) and Q; Vrabel won’t assume he’s out; Henderson and Spillane cleared; Pittman Jr. Q for PIT.

items.title: Stephon Gilmore Retires as Patriot After Iconic Career
items.one_line: Gilmore signed one-day deal and retired in Foxborough Friday; advised Gonzalez to ‘stay hungry’; SB LIII INT legacy.

items.title: Saints' Plan to Contain Lamar Jackson Draws Fan Backlash
items.one_line: Carl Granderson: keep Lamar in the pocket and hit; Ravens fans called it outdated after Lamar’s 324-yard Week 1.

items.title: Saints' Olave, Young Questionable; Kamara Set for Season Debut
items.one_line: Olave and Chase Young listed questionable; Alvin Kamara set for season debut at M&T Bank Stadium vs. Baltimore.

items.title: Giants Place Top-Paid CB Adebo on IR with Knee Injury
items.one_line: Paulson Adebo to IR (knee) — misses ≥4; no surgery planned; Nikko Reed signed from LAC PS; Banks day-to-day (calf).

items.title: Giants Sign CB Nikko Reed Amid Secondary Injury Wave
items.one_line: Reed elevated from Chargers PS as Adebo/Banks/Newsome deal with injuries ahead of MNF at Rams.

items.title: Giants and Rams Fans Trade Barbs Before Monday Night Clash
items.one_line: 1-0 Giants visit 0-1 Rams at SoFi Mon 8:15p ESPN/ABC; LAR -7 after Australia loss.

items.title: Jets Miss Key Starters but Rookie Ponds Set for NFL Debut vs. Packers
items.one_line: Out: Fitzpatrick, Omar Cooper Jr., Nwangwu, Ossai; D’Angelo Ponds cleared for debut; Will McDonald Q but likely.

items.title: Jets Rally Fans for White Out Home Opener vs. Packers
items.one_line: White-out MetLife with ponchos for rain; debut all-white alternate helmets; chase first 2-0 since 2015.

items.title: Packers Face Jets with Six-Game Skid on the Line
items.one_line: GB risking seventh straight loss at MetLife; Jets 1-0 but thin; O-line vs. NY blitz is the trench battle.

items.title: Eagles' Carter and DeJean Progress in Practice Before Titans Game
items.one_line: Jalen Carter (wrist) and Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) upgraded to limited; Carter: ‘I’m playing this week’; Mukuba new knee concern.

items.title: Hollywood Brown Frustrated After Zero Snaps in Eagles Opener
items.one_line: Healthy scratch Week 1 vs. WSH despite one-year deal; Sirianni pledged more involvement soon in deep WR room.

items.title: Eagles Fans Take Over Nashville for Titans Clash
items.one_line: PA tickets 29% vs. TN 12%; PHI -7 in all-white; heat ~105° real feel at Nissan prompted early arrival.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr. Out for Steelers' Patriots Game Amid Contract Standoff
items.one_line: Porter Jr. out second straight (back/conditioning) with extension talks stalled over guarantees; Pittman Jr. and Fautanu Q.

items.title: Patriots Host Steelers with Maye Seeking Week 1 Rebound
items.one_line: NE -5 at Gillette; Maye bouncing from 3-INT SEA loss; Rodgers/Watt fueled PIT’s Week 1 ATL win.

items.title: Seahawks Turn to Drew Lock with Darnold Out for Glute Injury
items.one_line: Sam Darnold out Sunday at ARI (glute, 3–4 weeks vibe); Lock starts next two; Okada out (ham); Emmanwori/Bradford Q.

items.title: Seahawks Rookie Jadarian Price Earns Bigger Role After Strong Debut
items.one_line: First-rounder Price 10-52 (5.2 YPC) in Week 1; Fleury promises more reps with Walker gone and Charbonnet hurt.

items.title: 49ers Face Kicker Uncertainty with Piñeiro Missing Practices Before Dolphins Game
items.one_line: Eddy Piñeiro missed all week (illness) and is Q; club signing PS kicker insurance; Kaelon Black Q (groin); Stribling to IR (ankle).

items.title: 49ers Monitor Rookie Black's Groin Injury After Strong Debut
items.one_line: Black limited Thu after 65-yard Week 1; Lynch/Shanahan: committee with CMC to stay fresh; expect ready vs. MIA.

items.title: 49ers Heavy Favorites in Home Opener vs Dolphins
items.one_line: 1-0 SF hosts 0-1 MIA as ~13.5 favorites on FOX after Australia rout of LAR.

items.title: Browns and Bucs Face Injury Questions Before Week 2 Clash
items.one_line: TB: no doubtful but Parrish (back), McMillan (knee), Killebrew (concussion) are Q game-time calls vs. CLE.

items.title: Baker Mayfield Faces Browns and Watson in Tampa Rematch
items.one_line: Mayfield hosts Watson in first head-to-head since the 2022 Cleveland swap; both clubs 0-1.

items.title: Titans Name Rookie Anthony Hill Jr. Starting Middle Linebacker vs Eagles
items.one_line: Second-rounder Hill Jr. (16 tackles Week 1) starts MIKE vs. PHI; Saleh praised communication; Barton/Gray cleared concussion.

items.title: Titans Wear '60%' Shirts Echoing Saleh's Familiar Motivation
items.one_line: Saleh’s 40% rule shirts are back in Nashville; Restrepo explained untapped capacity message after Jets loss.

items.title: Titans' Simmons Gives Eagles Bulletin-Board Fuel Targeting Hurts' Runs
items.one_line: Jeffery Simmons: keep Hurts in the pocket; Eagles fans pointed to Hurts’ 2022 torching of TEN as bulletin-board fuel.

items.title: Commanders Rule Out Okonkwo and Luvu for Cowboys Clash
items.one_line: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) and Frankie Luvu (groin) out Sunday at DAL; Sonny Styles calling with Leo Chenal; Kinlaw Q (back).

items.title: Cowboys Host Commanders in Key NFC East Get-Right Clash
items.one_line: Both 0-1 after Week 1 heartbreaks; AT&T 4:25p FOX; Dak historically dominant vs. WSH.

items.title: Laremy Tunsil Calls Out Texans Fans for Booing His False Starts
items.one_line: Now with Commanders, Tunsil said Houston booed his 2024 false starts; fans pointed to his league-leading penalties.
